sources.t: Openreach proposed commercial offers consultation
sources.f: Published 28 July 2026; Ofcom proposed intervention on one notified Openreach FTTP and Ethernet commercial offer while consulting until 27 August 2026.
sources.g: A provisional wholesale competition assessment does not prove current service at a premises.

sources.t: Openreach proposed commercial offers call for inputs
sources.f: Published 2 June 2026; Ofcom requested initial stakeholder views on conditional and geographic Openreach pricing offers.
sources.g: Wholesale pricing consultation evidence is not exact-address orderability evidence.

sources.t: The Communications Market 2026
sources.f: Published 30 June 2026; Ofcom provides an interactive communications-market portal and downloadable telecoms data.
sources.g: National and market-level datasets require exact-address validation before parcel use.

sources.t: Communications Market Report 2026 interactive data
sources.f: Published 30 June 2026; the interactive report combines industry submissions, Ofcom consumer research and selected third-party headline figures.
sources.g: Interactive aggregate market data are not current parcel connectivity truth.

sources.t: Code powers for Clear Mobitel Ltd
sources.f: Updated 22 July 2026; Ofcom published a final direction after consulting on Code powers for Clear Mobitel Ltd.
sources.g: Regulatory authorisation does not establish built network or active service at an address.

sources.t: Code powers for London Fibre Group Limited
sources.f: Updated 15 May 2026; Ofcom published its statement and final direction for London Fibre Group Limited.
sources.g: Code powers are enabling regulation, not evidence of parcel coverage.

sources.t: Code powers for Boom Telecom Networks Limited
sources.f: Updated 19 May 2026; Ofcom published a final direction concerning Boom Telecom Networks Limited.
sources.g: A final direction does not prove infrastructure construction or retail availability.

sources.t: Code powers for Village Networks Limited
sources.f: Updated 14 May 2026; Ofcom published the final direction for Village Networks Limited.
sources.g: Operator status is not exact-premises service evidence.

sources.t: Code powers for Jet Infrastructure Limited
sources.f: Updated 27 January 2026; Ofcom published its statement on Code powers for Jet Infrastructure Limited.
sources.g: Regulatory status cannot be promoted to current network reach or orderability.

sources.t: Code powers for Baltic Broadband Limited
sources.f: Updated 30 January 2026; Ofcom published a final direction for Baltic Broadband Limited.
sources.g: A Code direction is not proof of a live connection at a parcel.

sources.t: Project Gigabit network build contract Cheshire
sources.f: Updated 27 February 2026; BDUK records termination of the Freedom Fibre contract and inclusion of around 18,500 premises in Openreach call-off eight.
sources.g: Contract replacement and planned scope do not prove current retail service.

sources.t: Project Gigabit contract Buckinghamshire Hertfordshire East Berkshire
sources.f: Updated 26 May 2026; BDUK records a redesigned CityFibre contract covering around 6,000 premises.
sources.g: Revised contract scope is planning evidence, not exact-address availability.

sources.t: Project Gigabit network build contract Cambridgeshire
sources.f: Updated 26 May 2026; BDUK records a redesigned Cambridgeshire contract covering around 35,000 premises.
sources.g: Contract scope and investment figures require current address-level confirmation.

sources.t: Project Gigabit network build contract East and West Sussex
sources.f: Updated 26 May 2026; BDUK records a redesigned East and West Sussex contract covering around 13,000 premises.
sources.g: A revised intervention plan does not establish completed or orderable service.

sources.t: Project Gigabit contract Nottinghamshire and West Lincolnshire
sources.f: Updated 26 May 2026; BDUK states the CityFibre contract ended after market and commercial-rollout changes.
sources.g: Contract termination and alternative planning are not current parcel connectivity evidence.

sources.t: Project Gigabit contract West Herefordshire and Forest of Dean
sources.f: Updated 14 April 2026; BDUK records termination of the FullFibre contract and inclusion of West Herefordshire in Openreach call-off three.
sources.g: Replacement procurement status does not prove service at an individual premises.

sources.t: Project Gigabit framework agreement Openreach
sources.f: Updated 2 March 2026; BDUK lists Openreach call-offs, including Cheshire, and warns premises and delivery scope can change.
sources.g: Framework and call-off lists are programme evidence, not exact current orderability.

sources.t: Project Gigabit contracts collection
sources.f: The official collection indexes awarded Project Gigabit contract guidance across the UK.
sources.g: A contract index is discovery evidence and cannot establish parcel service.

sources.t: Project Gigabit Evaluation Plan
sources.f: The official evaluation plan defines evaluation approaches for Gigabit Infrastructure Subsidy and voucher interventions.
sources.g: Evaluation design and eligible-premises processes do not prove current connection availability.

sources.t: Bedfordshire Northamptonshire and Milton Keynes closure notice
sources.f: Updated 23 June 2026; the closure notice records public-review outcomes and intervention-area materials.
sources.g: Public-review classifications and maps require current UPRN and provider validation.
